name: io.github.tonyyang0504/aws_marketplace-mcp
description: AWS Marketplace (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: AWS access key id of the seller account's IAM principal with aws-marketplace:ListEntities, DescribeEntity and SearchAgreements (e.g. the AWSMarketplaceSellerProductsReadOnly policy plus agreement read access).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The matching AWS secret access key; only used to derive the SigV4 signing key.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_MARKETPLACE_ENTITY_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Catalog entity type of your listings: SaaSProduct, AmiProduct, ContainerProduct, DataProduct (or Offer).
